title: The Shotgun Booby Trap (The Case Of)
summary: LegalEagle analyzes Katko v. Briney, the Iowa case about a homeowner whose shotgun booby trap injured a burglar, and the limits on deadly force in defending property.
why: HN cites it as a source on the illegality of lethal booby traps, including in discussions of trapping hackers.

quote.text: Potentially lethal boobytraps left in derelict buildings are mostly illegal in the US[1]
